purpose: Record how the two mutable transition-control files are governed, now that they are excluded from the immutable Stage 1 contract manifest.
exclusionIsByExactPath: Two full repository-relative paths. NOT a filename pattern, suffix, directory or mutability heuristic — any of those could silently grow to exclude a governed contract.

whyTheyMustBeMutable.statement: The authorized transition changes exactly these two files and nothing else. Hashing them in the Stage 1 manifest made that transition impossible.
whyTheyMustBeMutable.mechanism: Changing them would make the manifest stale, and the transition commit cannot also regenerate the manifest because the execute gate would then observe a third changed path and reject the transition.
consequenceIfLeftUncorrected: the Stage 1 manifest test would fail in ordinary npm test
Job A would halt at its first step, before bundle preparation

whatTheStage1ManifestBinds: the immutable reviewed IMPLEMENTATION and contract package: every governed contract, the freeze script, the canonical libraries and every Stage 1 test
boundToTheImplementationBy: execute-authorization.json#reviewedImplementationSha, which names the exact reviewed implementation head

exclusionDoesNotMeanUncontrolled.statement: These files are governed by a DIFFERENT mechanism, not by none.
controls: Git commit identity: the transition is a specific commit with a specific parent
exact control-state validation: the mode bytes and the authorization status and reviewed SHA must form one of the three coherent states
exact changed-path validation: every path changed since the reviewed implementation SHA must be one of the two permitted transition paths
full-history ancestry: the execute-transition gate job checks out with fetch-depth 0 and verifies the head descends from the reviewed SHA
external approval: the unpushed transition commit is reviewed and authorized by its exact SHA before it is pushed

externalApprovalRequirement: The transition commit is created locally and NOT pushed. Its full SHA, parent SHA, exact two-file list and byte diffs are reported, explicit owner authorization naming that SHA is obtained, and only then is it pushed. A branch-local workflow cannot prove that an unreviewed commit did not replace its own gate; that is why approval happens outside the workflow.

provenanceCorrection.source: execute-authorization.json records ocrRun true after governed execute attempt 1
